english.title: Cause a recording of a performance made without sufficient consent to be communicated to the public
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused a recording of a performance, namely **(..SPECIFY PERFORMANCE..), that had been made without sufficient consent to be communicated to the public thereby infringing a right conferred by Chapter 2 of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RIGHT..), knowing or having reason to believe that the right was thereby infringed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(2)(b) and (6) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
